procedure: Pages rendered with pdfplumber page.to_image(resolution=220); the five pages are PORTRAIT sheets whose rotated landscape tables read upright after PIL ROTATE_270 (cache/2026-scan-assessment/tier1/franklin/). Every in-scope row's cross-page cell sum equals its printed TOTAL exactly (12/12).
structure_note: Same two-table shape as the other Tier-1 five-page sheets: p1 is the certification/signature page (signed Nov 12, 'General Election'); p2+p3 = table A over the county's 14 precincts (11 columns, then Roxie/Wesley Chapel/Whittington + TOTAL) carrying the state-office sections; p4+p5 = table B (same column split) carrying the Chancery 4 Place 3 continuation, Circuit 6-2, and the local sections. The SEMS row-block split repeats the Adams pattern: 'Chancery Court 4-Chancery District 04 Place 3' carries TWO candidates on the district's shared ballot -- Debbra K. Halford's row completes table A (under the Place 3 header at p3's bottom) and Ashunda Hampton's row starts p4 ahead of the local zone with no header repeat (the same section split Adams' sheet printed). Circuit 6 Place 1 (Carmen Brooks Drake) prints NO section on this sheet at all -- Franklin has no precinct in Place 1's sub-district, so the family carries only Place 2 (Debra W. Blackwell). Races: U.S. Senate; US House Of Rep 02-2nd Congressional District; Court Of Appeals 04-District 4 Position 2 (David McCarty, sole candidate -- the same section Adams/Copiah/Covington print, roster identical); Chancery Court 4-Chancery District 04 Place 1 (E. Vincent Davis), Place 2 (Wayne Smith), Place 3 (Debbra K. Halford, Ashunda Hampton) -- the same Chancery 4 roster Adams prints, names identical; Circuit Court 6-2-Circuit District 6-2 (Debra W. Blackwell). Printed totals: Colom 1249, Hyde-Smith 2019, Pinkins 50, Eller 2000, G. Thompson 1238, Foster 70, McCarty 2546, E. Vincent Davis 2545, Wayne Smith 2576, Halford 2468, Hampton 734, Blackwell 2642.
operator_rows_note: All 12 in-scope rows supplied by operator_rows in ballot order; table-A rows carry p2 (eleven precinct cells) + p3 (three precinct cells + printed TOTAL); Hampton's and Blackwell's rows carry p4 + p5 cells + the p5 printed TOTAL. No X cells print in any in-scope row.
truncation_note: No truncations; the fourteen precinct headers print complete (Antioch, Bad Bayou, Bude, Cains, Eddiceton, Hamburg, Knoxville, Lucien, Mccall, Meadville, Pine Grove, Roxie, Wesley Chapel, Whittington).
local_note: p4/p5 carry the local sections after Circuit 6-2: School Board 5-School Board (Lindsay Smith Priest, Kristen A. Temple) -- local, out of scope, contributing no parse rows on operator-supply pages. Circuit 6 on this sheet carries only the Place 2 section: with no Franklin precinct in Place 1's sub-district, SEMS prints no Place 1 section and the single printed seat keeps the bare 'Circuit Court' label district 6; the cross-county roster gate records the difference against Adams as an advisory roster_subset.
